item.title: Van Hollen Says He Has Momentum in Bid to Lead Senate Democrats
item.description: Senator Chris Van Hollen pressed his bid Sunday to replace Chuck Schumer as leader of the incoming Democratic Senate majority, arguing that the party needs new leadership to deliver on the economic promises that helped it win the midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Se Young Lee

item.title: Strongman’s Son Nominated for Premier of Bosnia’s Serb Entity
item.description: The son of Bosnian Serb strongman Milorad Dodik, who until last year, along with his father, was subject to US sanctions for corruption and siphoning of public funds, has been nominated as the next prime minister of Republika Srpska, one of two entities that make up Bosnia-Herzegovina.
item.dc:creator: Jasmina Kuzmanovic

item.title: Democrats, Republicans Eye the 2028 Field
item.description: Democratic strategist Ravi Gupta and Republican strategist Leslie Shedd tell Bloomberg This Weekend that the 2028 presidential race remains wide open as both parties assess the lessons of the midterms and potential candidates begin defining their messages. Gupta, founder and CEO of The Branch, and Shedd, president of Rising Communications, tell hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that affordability will remain central to both parties while Democrats weigh investigations of the Trump administration and Republicans reconsider their messaging after their midterm losses. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Probing Alleged Spy Tied to Ex-Nvidia CEO, Spy Chief Says
item.description: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said Nvidia Corp. is a perpetual target for people trying to illegally obtain its high-end chips and the US is investigating an alleged Chinese spy who had an affair with the company’s former chief executive.
item.dc:creator: Jorgelina do Rosario

item.title: Rep. McCaul Seeks Answers From Jensen Huang
item.description: Republican Congressman Michael McCaul tells Bloomberg This Weekend that he wants answers from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang about the company’s chip sales and whether advanced AI technology reached China in violation of US export controls, amid scrutiny of Huang’s relationship with a woman accused of ties to Chinese intelligence. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, McCaul also says Vladimir Putin is an adversary rather than a US friend, calls for investment to strengthen vulnerable federal technology systems and urges Republicans to learn from their midterm losses as he prepares to leave Congress. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: East Libya Says Blast on Russian Ship Likely Due to Attack
item.description: An explosion on board a Russian ship docked at Benghazi’s naval base early Sunday was likely due to an attack by “unmanned vehicles,” Eastern Libyan authorities said, before more strikes in the same area caused another vessel to catch fire.
item.dc:creator: Hatem Mohareb

item.title: Trump Tests Common Ground With Democrats
item.description: Bloomberg White House correspondent Hadriana Lowenkron tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump may look for areas of cooperation with a Democratic-controlled Congress after the midterms, including credit card interest rates, health care and immigration. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lowenkron also explains how the White House is responding to recent aviation infrastructure problems as affordability and other domestic concerns take on greater political importance. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Power Advantage Over China Shrinks Further on Iran War Effect
item.description: The advantage the US has over China in influencing the course of international events has shrunk to the smallest level since 2018, with the Iran war and unilateralism undermining its military and diplomatic strength, according to a new report.
item.dc:creator: James Mayger

item.title: Russian Attacks on Energy Sites Strain Ukraine Power Supply
item.description: Russia’s defense ministry said its forces struck several targets in Ukraine overnight, including a power station, port infrastructure facilities and a cargo ship, according to a statement on Telegram.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: ICE Arrest at Airport Prompts Outcry From Officials, Politicians
item.description: An arrest by federal immigration agents at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport sparked outrage among officials and politicians Saturday, and intensified scrutiny of Immigration and Customs Enforcement as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and investigate the agency’s tactics.
item.dc:creator: Michael B. Marois

item.title: FDA Leadership Search Includes Cancer Care CEO, RFK Jr. Adviser
item.description: The Trump administration is considering Sara Brenner, a senior adviser at the Department of Health and Human Services, and Jeff Vacirca, head of a New York oncology group, for leadership positions at the Food and Drug Administration as the FDA’s top ranks undergo another shakeup, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Cohrs Zhang
